commands:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(uname -s)" = Darwin
cd /tmp/bloomml-m03.Iyqgfp/source
BASE=2e816ce6a8b57d47e98028b3f27d6f359c40025e
CODE=4fc585d3155bddb115d3c5e6a52123f791edaf8c
PUBLISH="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
case "$PUBLISH" in f091bdd*) ;; *) echo UNEXPECTED_LOCAL_HEAD; exit 1;; esac
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD^)" = "$CODE"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test "$(git diff --binary "$BASE" "$CODE" | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')" = 1c0ea4b9f9c3c1adec9fe2768532bc7159934aacf494c3c945b25f5392882b40
git diff --check "$BASE" HEAD
git fetch origin main
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$BASE"
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$BASE" "$PUBLISH"
git log --format='%h %s' "$BASE"..HEAD
# Retry the ordinary authorized fast-forward only once. Never bypass a rule.
git push --porcelain origin HEAD:main
test "$(git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main | awk '{print $1}')" = "$PUBLISH"
echo "M03_PUBLISHED_SHA|$PUBLISH"
echo M03_CLOSED_SCOPED
